statement.p: Match the solutions to the differential equations. If there is more than one solution to an equation, select the answer that includes all solutions.

li.p: y = e^{-8 x} or y = e^{8 x}

static.solution:
\frac{d}{dx} (e^{-8 x}) = -8 e^{-8 x},
\frac{d^2}{dx^2} (e^{-8 x}) = 64 e^{-8 x},
\frac{d}{dx} (e^{8 x}) = 8 e^{-8 x},
\frac{d^2}{dx^2} (e^{-8 x}) = 64 e^{-8 x},
\frac{d}{dx} (\sin(8 x)) = 8 \cos(8 x),
\frac{d^2}{dx^2} (\sin(8 x)) = -64 \sin(8 x),
\frac{d}{dx} (8 \sin(x)) = 8 \cos(x), and
\frac{d^2}{dx^2} (8 \sin(x)) = -8 \sin(8 x).
Thus, the correct answers are:
\frac{d^2y}{dx^2}=64 y : C,
\frac{d^2y}{dx^2}=-64 y : E,
\frac{dy}{dx}=8 y : A, and
\frac{dy}{dx}=-8 y : D
